company.shortDescription: comma is solving self driving cars while delivering shippable intermediaries: openpilot and the comma two.
company.description: Comma is a self-driving car kit founded by George Hotz to show that making driverless vehicles could done relatively cheaply using off-the-shelf components and existing vehicles. It has open-sourced a dataset of 7.25 hours of highway driving.

productsAndServices.description: An open-source driver-assistance system that provides adaptive cruise control, automated lane centering, and lane-change assistance on compatible vehicles.
productsAndServices.name: openpilot

productsAndServices.description: A windshield-mounted automotive computer that runs openpilot and provides camera-based driver assistance, including lane centering, adaptive cruise control, and lane changing.
productsAndServices.name: comma four

productsAndServices.description: A web-based dashboard and companion service for managing openpilot drives, reviewing recordings and routes, and accessing connected vehicle features.
productsAndServices.name: comma connect

productsAndServices.description: An optional subscription for comma connect that provides cellular connectivity, cloud storage for drive videos, live vehicle tracking, remote snapshots, and other connected-device features.
productsAndServices.name: comma prime

productsAndServices.description: A vehicle-integration service that adds openpilot support for a specified car make and model, including required interface hardware and a working comma four installation.
productsAndServices.name: Custom car ports

productsAndServices.description: An optional warranty-extension service that adds up to one year of coverage to a comma four’s standard one-year hardware warranty.
